title: Why pay 55 million dirhams for a number plate?
note: The plates in the reel are drawings, not copies of real plate designs. The counts per code letter are plain arithmetic: 9 single digit numbers, 90,000 five digit numbers.

facts.said: Plate P 7 sold for AED 55 million at an auction in Dubai on 8 April 2023.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, New record set as car number plate P7 sells for Dh55 million (8 Apr 2023)
Guinness World Records, Dubai driver drops nearly $15 million on most expensive license plate ever (May 2023)

facts.said: Guinness World Records lists it as the most expensive number plate.

sources.name: Guinness World Records, Dubai driver drops nearly $15 million on most expensive license plate ever (May 2023)

facts.said: A Dubai plate can have up to five digits. P 7 has one.

sources.name: RTA, 90 distinctive plate numbers at open auction (Dec 2025)

facts.said: The fewer the digits, the rarer and more expensive the plate.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, Dh55 million for a car number plate? Why they cost so much

facts.note: The row counts in the picture are arithmetic, not RTA figures.

facts.said: The bidding opened at AED 15 million and passed 30 million within seconds.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, New record set as car number plate P7 sells for Dh55 million (8 Apr 2023)

facts.said: The record it beat: plate 1 in Abu Dhabi, AED 52.2 million, 2008.

sources.name: CNN via Newshub, World's most expensive licence plate sells for US$15 million (Apr 2023)
Khaleej Times, How UAE set a world record to feed the hungry (Apr 2023)

facts.said: All the proceeds went to a food aid fund, the 1 Billion Meals Endowment.
